summary: Rulebooks define event sources and conditional rules whose actions are run_playbook (CLI only), run_module, run_job_template, run_workflow_template, set_fact, post_event, retract_fact, print_event, shutdown, debug and none. An activation runs a rulebook in a decision environment; without Redis you cannot create, delete, enable, disable or restart activations.
questions: What actions can an Event-Driven Ansible rulebook run?
Is run_playbook supported in Event-Driven Ansible controller?
Why can't I restart a rulebook activation when Redis is down?

answer_card.title: Rulebook actions in EDA controller
answer_card.answer_md:
Supported: `run_job_template`, `run_workflow_template`, `run_module`, `set_fact`, `post_event`, `retract_fact`, `print_event`, `shutdown`, `debug`, `none`.

`run_playbook` works **only with the ansible-rulebook CLI**, not in the controller. Use `run_job_template` there.
